summary: Regression smoke test after removing `output: 'standalone'` from next.config.js and cleaning add-ons paragraph from /terms. All five requested flows PASS. Home renders with ₹799, /terms shows flat ₹799 with no add-on/Custom Domain/Concierge mentions, onboard→publish page loads with publish-grand-total=₹799, upi-qr present, UPI id anoopsunny04@ybl present, publish-addons absent, submit-payment-btn produces verification-pending screen (badge went 3→2 pending on admin sidebar after approval). Admin login lands on dashboard (not blank), Payments page lists the ₹799 Deploy & Check item with WA 919000000021, and after APPROVE & PUBLISH the Owner Hub at /hub/manage/<ownerToken> loads LIVE state ('🎊 You're live!', WEBSITE CRAFTED→PAYMENT RECEIVED→YOU'RE LIVE journey, public-link CTA, PAYMENT TIMELINE APPROVED) and is NOT stuck on 'pending payment'.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin auth uses localStorage key 'kal_token' — legacy Kalyanam naming; consider renaming to 'vivoha_admin_token' for brand consistency (non-blocking).
Fonts .woff2 preload warnings in console (preloaded but not used within a few seconds) — harmless but worth cleaning up unused font preloads in Next.js head.
seed_data_creation: Created wedding 'Deploy & Check' (slug=deploy-check, ownerToken=kNwdRP3vBRmUYApsmSChy4kDLn2MsRw7) via POST /api/onboard/start, submitted manual payment screenshot from publish page, then APPROVED via admin to verify live-hub flow. Pending payments badge decremented 3→2.
context_for_next_testing_agent: next.config.js no longer has `output: 'standalone'`; build output is standard .next dir. /terms page copy is scrubbed of Optional add-ons/Custom Domain/Concierge references. Admin endpoints observed: /api/admin/payments, /api/admin/hubs (has ownerToken), /api/admin/badges. Non-existent: /api/admin/weddings, /api/admin/dashboard.
